name: _scroll-lock.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  modal/_scroll-lock.scss — scroll-lock rules — html.modal-open overflow locks, the dialog.modal-above fullscreen layer, and the .modal-open page state (nav hidden, modal titlebar shown).
//  Imported by modal.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// No html-level overflow lock: the root scroller's overflow:hidden
// collapses documentElement.scrollTop to 0 (visible page jump). The
// expand <dialog>'s inert top layer + overscroll-behavior:contain is the
// lock; body's overflow below covers engines where body itself scrolls.

// The expand dialog: fixed fullscreen layer above everything (media expand view).
dialog.modal-above,
.modal-above {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 100vw;
  max-width: 100vw;
  height: 100vh;
  height: 100dvh;
  max-height: 100dvh;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  z-index: 9999;
  overflow-y: auto;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  // Transparent by design — the glass surface lives on
  // .expand-modal-content (translucent dark + backdrop blur); the
  // dialog frame and its ::backdrop must let the page show through so
  // the genie funnel reads as liquid glass over the still-visible
  // page, not an opaque black mass.
  background: transparent;
  color: inherit;

  &::backdrop {
    background: transparent;
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
  }
}

// Page state when a modal is open.
.modal-open {
  // Lock page scroll behind the modal — the native dialog's inert top
  // layer is the primary lock; this overflow guard covers engines whose
  // modal inertness doesn't block document scrolling. No fixed-position
  // pin: the document keeps its real scroll offset → zero shift.
  body {
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  // Hide regular nav links in modal context
  .nav .nav-link {
    display: none;
  }

  // Show modal title bar instead
  .modal-titlebar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }
}
